title: Go TUI Todo List MVP
objective: Build a minimal but polished Go CLI TUI for managing a personal todo list. The MVP supports three status tabs (未开始 / 进行中 / 已完成), keyboard navigation, adding todos, toggling completion with Space, marking in-progress with `i`, and local JSON persistence. The storage layer is designed behind an interface so future providers can be swapped in.

assertions: `go build ./...` succeeds without errors.
Running the binary launches a TUI with three tabs labeled 未开始, 进行中, and 已完成.
Pressing `n` opens a prompt to enter a new todo title; pressing Enter saves it and it appears under the 未开始 tab.
Pressing ↑/↓ moves the selection indicator through todos in the current tab.
Pressing ←/→ switches the active tab and updates the filtered list.
Pressing Space on a non-已完成 todo marks it 已完成; pressing Space on a 已完成 todo marks it 未开始.
Pressing `i` on a selected todo marks it 进行中.
Todos are persisted to a JSON file in the XDG config directory; after quitting and relaunching, the same todos appear in the correct tabs.
Pressing `q` or Ctrl+C exits the application cleanly.
The JSON storage file is human-readable and contains id, title, status, and created_at for each todo.

features.title: Go module and project layout
features.spec: Initialize the Go module and project layout. Create `cmd/todo-list/main.go` as the entry point, set up internal packages for `storage`, `todo`, and `tui`. Add dependencies to `go.mod`: `github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea`, `github.com/charmbracelet/lipgloss`, `github.com/charmbracelet/bubbles`, and `github.com/adrg/xdg`. Ensure `go build ./...` succeeds. Do not implement business logic yet.
assertions: `go build ./...` succeeds without errors.

features.title: Todo domain model and JSON storage interface
features.spec: Define a `Todo` struct with fields `ID`, `Title`, `Status` (one of 未开始 / 进行中 / 已完成), and `CreatedAt`. Define a `Storage` interface with Add, Update, Delete, and List methods. Implement a JSON-file-backed storage at the XDG config directory (e.g., `~/.config/todo-list/todos.json`). The JSON file must be human-readable and persist `id`, `title`, `status`, and `created_at`. The interface-based design must allow future providers to be swapped in.
assertions: Todos are persisted to a JSON file in the XDG config directory; after quitting and relaunching, the same todos appear in the correct tabs.
The JSON storage file is human-readable and contains id, title, status, and created_at for each todo.

features.spec: Write unit tests for the storage layer in `internal/storage`. Cover Add/Update/Delete/List, JSON file format, and persistence round-trip. Use a temporary directory for test isolation. Ensure `go test ./...` passes.
assertions: `go build ./...` succeeds without errors.
Todos are persisted to a JSON file in the XDG config directory; after quitting and relaunching, the same todos appear in the correct tabs.

features.title: Bubble Tea app scaffold
features.spec: Scaffold the Bubble Tea application. Define the main model with state for active tab, selected index, todos, input mode, and input buffer. Implement `Init`, `Update`, and `View`. Wire the entry point in `cmd/todo-list/main.go` to call `tea.NewProgram`. Ensure the app starts and exits cleanly with `q` or `Ctrl+C`.
assertions: `go build ./...` succeeds without errors.
Running the binary launches a TUI with three tabs labeled 未开始, 进行中, and 已完成.
Pressing `q` or Ctrl+C exits the application cleanly.

features.title: Render tabs and filtered todo list
features.spec: Render a tab bar with three tabs labeled 未开始, 进行中, 已完成. Render the todos filtered by the active tab status, with a selection indicator on the currently selected item. Use `lipgloss` for minimal styling: distinct active/inactive tab styles. Handle empty tabs gracefully.
assertions: Running the binary launches a TUI with three tabs labeled 未开始, 进行中, and 已完成.
Pressing ↑/↓ moves the selection indicator through todos in the current tab.
Pressing ←/→ switches the active tab and updates the filtered list.

features.title: Keyboard navigation
features.spec: Implement keyboard handling: ↑/↓ move selection within the current tab; ←/→ switch tabs and reset selection to the first item of the new tab; `q` or `Ctrl+C` quit. Ensure selection bounds are respected and an empty tab does not crash.
assertions: Pressing ↑/↓ moves the selection indicator through todos in the current tab.
Pressing ←/→ switches the active tab and updates the filtered list.
Pressing `q` or Ctrl+C exits the application cleanly.

features.title: Add new todo input flow
features.spec: Pressing `n` enters input mode and shows a prompt for the todo title. Typing fills the input. Enter saves the todo with status 未开始 and returns to list view; Esc cancels. The new todo appears immediately in the 未开始 tab and is persisted to JSON.
assertions: Pressing `n` opens a prompt to enter a new todo title; pressing Enter saves it and it appears under the 未开始 tab.
Todos are persisted to a JSON file in the XDG config directory; after quitting and relaunching, the same todos appear in the correct tabs.

features.title: Space toggles completion
features.spec: Pressing Space on a selected todo whose status is not 已完成 changes it to 已完成. Pressing Space on a 已完成 todo changes it back to 未开始. Changes are persisted immediately and the list re-renders in the correct tab.
assertions: Pressing Space on a non-已完成 todo marks it 已完成; pressing Space on a 已完成 todo marks it 未开始.
Todos are persisted to a JSON file in the XDG config directory; after quitting and relaunching, the same todos appear in the correct tabs.

features.title: Mark in-progress with `i`
features.spec: Pressing `i` on a selected todo sets its status to 进行中. The change is persisted immediately and the todo moves to the 进行中 tab. The selection state updates gracefully.
assertions: Pressing `i` on a selected todo marks it 进行中.
Todos are persisted to a JSON file in the XDG config directory; after quitting and relaunching, the same todos appear in the correct tabs.

features.title: Lipgloss styling and layout
features.spec: Polish the UI with `lipgloss`. Style the tab bar, selected todo row, input prompt, and help footer with a cohesive color scheme. The active tab and selected item must be clearly highlighted. Keep the layout responsive to terminal width without crashing.
assertions: Running the binary launches a TUI with three tabs labeled 未开始, 进行中, and 已完成.

features.title: Help footer with keybindings
features.spec: Add a persistent help bar/footer displaying keybindings: ↑/↓ navigate, ←/→ switch tabs, n add, Space toggle complete, i in-progress, q quit. The help text must be visible, concise, and unobtrusive.
assertions: Pressing `q` or Ctrl+C exits the application cleanly.
